skills.skill_desc: Every 8s, Aldous gains a shield equal to 350 (+ 3 per <font color="a6aafb">Soul Steal</font> stack) for 3s on his next Basic Attack. He also gains 60% Movement Speed for 1s.

Aldous enhances his next Basic Attack to deal 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 3 per <font color="a6aafb">Soul Steal</font> stack) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Killing a siege minion with this attack grants 12 <font color="a6aafb">Soul Steal</font> stacks; killing any other non-hero unit grants 5 stacks. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra 5 stack(s), while killing one grants 12 (up to 1000 stacks).

This attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to minions and creeps. Aldous also gains 6 stack(s) when allied units eliminate a nearby enemy siege minion, and 2 stack(s) when they eliminate any other nearby non-hero unit.

Aldous gains 20% Movement Speed while moving toward enemy heroes during this skill.

Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction for 2s or until canceled.
He then deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font>-400<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5-1s (scales with defensive stance duration).

Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5s.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: During this time, he dashes toward an enemy hero, dealing 250 (+ 8% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking the target back for 1s.
Aldous can interrupt the target's Recall while dashing.
